caption: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwebasiliek, Maastricht
composition: Romanesque westwork with two round stair turrets · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouwebasiliek shows its heavy Romanesque westwork on the square, pale stone with two round stair turrets. It does not have Gothic spires. The church is closed. It is clear, about 14.4°C, with wind near 9.4 km/h and cloud cover about 0%. The Sint-Servaasbasiliek is another church and is not in this frame.
